parsed.change_summary: Added a check to validate the file size before allocating memory. If the file size exceeds 10MB, the function returns an error.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding involves providing a very large file size, which would lead to a buffer overflow when allocating memory. By adding a check to limit the file size to 10MB, the function now prevents the allocation of excessive memory and thus blocks the trigger.
parsed.behavior_changes: The function now has a limit on the file size it can process (10MB). If a file larger than this size is provided, the function will fail and return an error.
